title: kate-text: return the scalar before an offset
summary: char_before returns the scalar before an offset. Offset 0 returns None. The test goes in the existing buffer tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

definitions.definition: pub fn char_before(&self, at: Offset) -> Option<char>

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: buffer.rs has one test module named tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Add char_before on impl TextBuffer. Use let-else. let Some(index) = at.0.checked_sub(1) else { return None; }; then self.char_at(Offset(index)). Do not match Option by hand. Do not nest an if inside an if. Do not touch char_at, last_char, len, line_count, line_col, offset, slice, or apply. The existing tests char_at_is_none_past_the_end and last_char_is_none_when_empty stay green. Do not rewrite their assertions. The test char_before_is_none_at_the_start checks TextBuffer::from_str of ab. char_before of Offset(0) is None. Offset(1) is Some('a'). Offset(2) is Some('b'). Offset(3) is None. TextBuffer::from_str of é, char_before of Offset(1) is Some('é'). Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines. Run the full test module named in the commands, not only the new test.

regression_tests.name: buffer::tests::char_before_is_none_at_the_start
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because char_before does not exist. After the change offset 0 returns None. Offset 1 in ab returns a. Offset 2 returns b. An offset past the end returns None.
